name: Bitpin (بیت‌پین)

limitations.detail: Official docs page docs.bitpin.ir did not render (title + deprecation notice only); paths/shapes inferred from docs anchors referenced by the community python-bitpin SDK and must be verified live
BitPin warns some v1 APIs will soon be deprecated; only the official API is supported
Candle/history endpoint params (interval unit=minutes, from_ts/to_ts=unix seconds) and {time,open,high,low,close,volume} shape not confirmed in corpus
Markets objects identified by integer id plus code; orderbook/orders/trades use numeric market_id, not symbol strings - adapter must map symbol->numeric id via markets list
Orderbook is side-specific (buy/sell fetched separately, v2 endpoint); combined depth shape not documented
No dedicated ticker endpoint documented; last price/24h stats embedded in markets list price_info
Auth is JWT bearer: POST login {api_key,secret_key} returns access/refresh tokens sent as Authorization header; no per-request HMAC - hmac block unused; token refresh interval per SDK defaults
create_order uses market(int), amount1, price, mode, type plus optional identifier/price_limit/price_stop/price_limit_oco/amount2 (OCO/stop); enum values not readable in corpus
Site offers tahodi (leveraged long/short) up to 80x, but no margin/futures API documented in corpus - margin=null; max_risk_coef=80 taken from website marketing, not API docs
min_order_usdt not documented - using conservative default 10.0
min_collateral_usdt/max_collateral_usdt/interest_per_4h_pct not documented - using defaults 10.0/100000.0/0.05
fee_pct not documented (fee tiers exist on site but values absent) - using conservative default 0.2
price_band_pct not documented - using default 5.0
qty_step not documented - using default 8
Rate limits per SDK notes: currencies/markets 10000/day or 200/minute authenticated, wallets 10000/day; other endpoint limits unstated - min_gap_sec=0.3 derived from 200/min
Provided doc pages were intro/redirect only; paths reconstructed from official BitPin API reference and python-bitpin SDK constants (API_URL https://api.bitpin.ir, version v1)
Candles/orderbook/recent-trades keyed by numeric market_id from /v1/mkt/markets/ results (field id), not symbol string; adapter must map symbol->id
Candle from/to params are unix seconds; no millisecond variants documented
Auth not covered in provided corpus; SDK shows Bearer JWT in Authorization header via POST /v1/usr/api/login/ and refresh via /v1/usr/refresh_token/
No dedicated REST ticker endpoint documented; last price available from markets list price_info.price
Orderbook response field names not fully documented; SDK exposes get_orderbook(market_id, type=buy|sell)
Order placement POST /v1/odr/orders/ exists (market, amount1, price, mode, type, price_limit/stop/oco, amount2) but mode/type enum values not documented in provided corpus
No margin/futures trading API documented â margin=null
min_order_usdt not documented â using conservative default 10.0
fee_pct not documented â using conservative default 0.2
qty_step not documented â using conservative default 8
price_band_pct not documented â using conservative default 5.0
min_collateral_usdt/max_collateral_usdt/max_risk_coef/interest_per_4h_pct not documented â defaults kept (margin unsupported)
Rate limits not documented â min_gap_sec set to conservative 1.0
Bitpin public API v1 has NO candle/ohlcv endpoint (chart is TradingView-WS only). Markets+prices verified live; candle-based features (chart/backtest) unavailable for this exchange.
